name: SCOUT Weather GNN
description: SCOUT's weather GNN as an ONNX model: a graph network (two GraphSAGE layers with mean aggregation and a linear head) that predicts five weather values at every node of a road graph from the WRF weather at the node. Inputs x (float32, nodes by 7: latitude, longitude, RAIN, T2, WSPD10, WDIR10, RH2) and edge_index (int64, 2 by edges: the source and target row of each edge); output prediction (float32, nodes by 5: RAIN, T2, RH2, WSPD10, WDIR10). The scout.routing package weights its routes with it. Exported once from SCOUT's backend/models/routing/gnn/rain_model.pth with scripts/scout/export_weather_gnn.py. From SCOUT, https://github.com/urban-toolkit/scout, used with the permission of SCOUT's authors.
